pages.text:
Read with the count, the circles become entries.

— Before any date: a single line, the oldest hand. "We count those who stay."
— 1849 … 1870: Orrin, witness. Orrin, witness. Orrin, witness. (each name scraped away and still legible in the scraping)
— 1871: one refused.
— Then blank leaves, for ninety-seven years.
— 1936: eleven points in a ring, in a hand nobody here can name.
— 1968, in old brown ink, the last line before the blank: a name, then "the eighth, witness."
